caption: The drawing features two main sections within outlined rectangles. The top section shows a close-up, side profile view of a male figure’s head and upper torso. The man has short dark hair, a full dark beard, and a mustache. His facial features are detailed, with a prominent nose and a focused expression looking toward the right. The visible portion of his clothing is in shades of green and brown. The lower and larger section presents a rear view of the same male figure, seated on a light-colored horse with a black tail. The man is depicted from behind, holding a golden-yellow object, possibly a sword or large feather, in his right hand, which is extended outward. His left hand is bent at the elbow and holds a small greenish object. He is dressed in a fitted garment featuring green, brown, and grey hues, with a red sash tied at the waist. He is wearing high brown boots. The horse stands on a rectangular brown platform. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery included.
title: Santo Bulto (Santiago or San Diego)
